name: Regular Planning Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA PLANNING COMMISSION

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701
  (562) 865-6262

  TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 19, 2019
  6:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

INVOCATION

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

Anyone wishing to speak to the Planning Commission should fill out a speaker card and
give that card to the Interim Planning Manager at the staff table prior to the
commencement of the meeting. Please observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when
giving your presentation. This time is for members of the public to address the
Commissioners on items that are not listed on the agenda. Any public comments that
cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting.

ADMINISTRATION OF OATH

Anyone wishing to speak on a Public Hearing item should stand and be sworn in by the
Interim City Attorney.

PUBLIC HEARING

  1. PUBLIC HEARING; AND RECONSIDERATION OF A VARIANCE FROM THE
  REQUIREMENTS OF ARTESIA MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 9-2.2805(M)(1)
  TO ALLOW FOR A ROOF SLOPE OF LESS THAN 3/12 FOR AN EXISTING
  REAR “COMMON ROOM” ADDITION AT 17916 THORNLAKE AVENUE IN THE
  SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (R-1) ZONE, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION
  OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA

  2. PUBLIC HEARING; AND CONSIDERATION OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
  TO ALLOW CHURCH AND RELIGIOUS USE AT 18616 SEINE AVENUE IN THE
  SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (R-1) ZONE, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION
  OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA

  Page 1 of 2
   3. PUBLIC HEARING; AND CONSIDERATION OF A DESIGN REVIEW APPROVAL
  FOR A PROPOSED 4-UNIT RESIDENTIAL APARTMENT COMPLEX AT 18721
  ARLINE AVENUE IN THE MULTI-FAMILY (M-R) ZONE, AND MAKING A
  DETERMINATION OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA.

DISCUSSION

  4.  DISCUSSION ITEM REGARDING POTENTIAL CHANGES TO CURRENT
  ZONING CODES

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

This is the time for additional general comment, announcements, and requests of staff
and/or other issues of concern to Commissioners that may briefly be presented at this
time.

  ADJOURNMENT TO
  REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  OF DECEMBER 17, 2019, AT 6:00 P.M.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate
in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to these
proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device (ALD) from the City Clerk. If you require said device, please come
forward to the City Clerk at the staff table for assistance.
